notes: Home of an entertainer. Charged as robbery and first degree burglary. The Capitol Hill location comes from a Capitol Hill Seattle headline; that page returned HTTP 403 and was not read, and the FOX 13 article does not name the neighborhood. The store was called a pawn shop by KOMO and a jewelry store by FOX 13. Police would not say in August whether the two defendants worked together. A KOMO photo caption says charging documents describe the primary suspect as getaway driver while another man pretended to shop for a watch, without saying which store or case. Labels such as pro athlete A are internal to the research file, not the sources.
